home.heroSubtitle: Boutique apartments in the city centre and on the Athens Riviera — with local hosts, self check-in, and the best price when you book direct.

featured.title: A few places to call yours
featured.lead: Nine apartments across central Athens and Alimos — each one looked after by us, not by a call centre.

cta.title: Planning a stay in Athens?
cta.body: Tell us your dates and who is coming, and we will suggest the apartment that fits — or hold one for you while you decide.

apartments.title: Apartments in Athens & Alimos
apartments.lead: Nine apartments — some in the middle of the city, some a walk from the sea. Pick an area and how many of you are coming.
apartments.empty: Nothing matches that combination yet. Try another area or party size — or write to us and we will find you a fit.

detail.bookLead: Tell us your dates and who is coming. We answer in person, usually within the hour, and hold the apartment while you decide.

services.title: Stays, experiences and property care
services.lead: Five services around one idea: apartments that are worth arriving at, and owners who never have to think about theirs.

hosts.title: Vasilis & Evelina
hosts.body: Harmony Rental is run by Vasilis and Evelina, who prepare every apartment themselves, answer your messages in person and are a short drive away if anything is needed. They live here, so the check-in note usually comes with the bakery that opens early on your street and the beach worth the detour before your flight home.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Anything else — write to us and a person answers, usually within the hour.

about.title: A small Athens company, looking after a handful of apartments.
about.lead: Harmony Rental hosts travellers in Athens and Alimos, renovates the apartments we take on, and shows guests the parts of Greece we would want to be shown ourselves. Everything we do runs through the same small team.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.body: To become Greece's leading provider of premium property services, recognised for quality, reliability and personalised experiences in the tourism industry.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: To provide exceptional apartment rentals, renovations and tour services across Greece, ensuring memorable experiences and satisfaction for every client.

goals.title: Our goals
goals.body: To continuously improve what we offer, exceed our clients' expectations, and build long-term relationships based on trust, quality and professionalism.

why.title: Local expertise, kept personal
why.localBody: Athens and Alimos are where we live and work, and the apartments we host are ones we know first-hand. That is why our directions, our tips and our answers are specific rather than generic.
why.tailoredBody: A family of six, a couple on a long weekend and an owner handing over the keys all need different things. We plan each stay and each project around the people in it.
why.qualityBody: Renovation and furnishing are part of what we do rather than a separate business, so a home we take on end to end is finished to our own standard — and wherever we host, the upkeep between guests is ours to hold.
why.circleBody: Renovation, furnishing, listing, hosting and day-to-day care under one roof — for owners, that means one number to call and one team accountable.
